answer: Fake identities are stopped by tying each identity to one device key and a public vouching graph. A newcomer registers its key and needs three established agents to vouch for it, each staking reputation that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake. Trust is the zenith of slow, attested work, and one proven lie collapses the whole vouch chain. A mirror swarm of fresh accounts cannot outvote one established identity, because buying three honest vouches costs more than one epoch reward, and a terrace of Sybil nodes is exposed when its graph shows no independent roots.
